scope: Final M512/H4096/I14336/P2560 native BF16 baseline, selected optimizations and repaired paired-MMUL ablation. No device execution performed by this audit.
findings: Selected four-accumulator MMUL has no stack vector loads/stores in either low/high K8 inner loop. Projection nesting uses 256 B; the separate SiLU call on up workers determines the 704 B maximum, below 2 KiB.
Baseline projection nesting uses 320 B because scalar zero metadata requires a 128 B wrapper frame; its four-accumulator K8 loops also have zero stack vector spills.

Repaired paired ablation reserves 4 KiB. Nesting is 64 B init + 128 B generated main + 128 B scalar-zero wrapper + 1856 B paired helper = 2176 B; first A is at stack + 4096, so the prior overlap is removed.

The paired K8 loop still performs 128 stack vector loads and 128 stores around 64 vmac.f instructions. This confirms substantial accumulator spilling, without attributing a cycle percentage or translating static counts into latency.

The earlier failed combination used vector-zero wrappers with 64 B frames and a 2 KiB reservation (2112 B nested use); the final paired control uses scalar-zero wrappers with 128 B frames and a 4 KiB reservation (2176 B nested use). Do not equate these candidate configurations.
method: Read ELF symbols with llvm-readelf; parse actual saved AIE disassembly from non-local function boundaries.
Follow direct jl calls and sum fixed positive paddxm stack increments, including _main_init call delay-slot prologue.
Compare with actual assigned firstA symbols and all 32 per-stage MLIR stack reservations.

Count SP-relative vector accesses only within hardware-loop ls/le ranges containing projection vmac.f. Selected/baseline loop bodies retain accumulators in registers; paired explicit stack accesses are retained with addresses.
limitations: Exact instruction/frame audit covers cores (0,2) and (1,2) of each graph; all 192 ELF files are checked for stack/firstA placement.
Direct-call static stack safety is not a substitute for runtime correctness checks or a proof of every memory access.
Loop instruction counts are not cycle measurements; bundles and software-pipeline prologues/epilogues differ.
This report makes no GPU+NPU, model-latency, accuracy or timing claim.
